integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic tests are illustrative; the all-size claim is proved by rational-grid concentration and direct-product structure. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite bounded commutative BCK-algebras, fixed equations only; excludes noncommutative/unbounded BCK algebras, quantified formulas and quasi-equations. Bound is nonoptimal. Earlier equivalent MV-algebra formulations remain possible.
title: Uniform finite satisfiability gaps for every equation of bounded commutative BCK-algebras
